alias_architecture.concept_aliases: legacy concept layer only (concept_id FK); alias_type synonym|abbreviation|legacy_name|spelling_variant|source_label
alias_architecture.source_aliases: source-scoped (source_id FK required, alias_kind is source vocabulary: source_slug|source_label|...); existing add_entity_alias apply target with alias_kind=source_label
alias_architecture.verdict: no source-agnostic reviewed-alias table existed; Phase 3 adds canonical_entity_aliases (mirrors concept_aliases conventions + review provenance), coexisting with source_aliases

lifecycle.trusted_definition: is_active AND review_status=approved AND status IN (reviewed, canonical)

primary_entity_id: FK to canonical_entities(id); proposals can never be primaries in production

proposal_layer.apply_script: scripts/apply-approved-kg-automation-proposals.ts (dry-run flag, idempotent existence checks, created_from_proposal_id provenance)
proposal_layer.review: review_status default generated; reviewed_by/reviewed_at/reviewer_notes; applied_at; superseded_by

promotion_flow_existing: automation proposes (kg_automation_proposals, review-gated) -> human review (anki reviewer workspace + adjudication route) -> apply script writes canonical_entities (status=reviewed, review_status=approved), bridges, source_aliases, relationships; claim_entities repointing and source-agnostic aliases were missing (added by Phase 3 applier)

canonical_entities.unique: slug (partial, not null); no cross-type label uniqueness (verification-gated)

ontology_governance_actions.note: promotion/alias decisions use entity_review_decisions; merge/replace lineage may additionally use this ledger
